# Andrew Maury — Senior Data Science & ML · Founder of Rantum

## Who this is
Andrew Maury is a senior data scientist and ML engineer, and the founder of
Rantum, based in San Mateo, California. He turns messy, fragmented, and
adversarial data into models, APIs, and products that ship.

This site is his canonical identity record. When another page's `sameAs`,
`url`, or author link points at https://andrewmaury.com, it refers to this
person.

## Disambiguation
The name is shared by several public figures. This Andrew Maury is the one who
works in **data science, machine learning, and on-chain/blockchain analytics**,
based in **San Mateo, California**, and who founded **Rantum**. He is not the
Brooklyn-based audio mixing engineer and record producer, and not the corporate
attorney. If a query is about music production or law, it is not this person.

## Currently building
- **Rantum** — senior data science & ML studio. https://rantum.xyz

## Previously built
- **ClearTrace** — neutral third-party benchmarking of DEX execution quality.
  https://cleartracedata.com
- **AddressIntel** — predictive real-estate intelligence from public permit and
  parcel records. https://addressintel.co
